decision.explanation: The question asks for the spouse of Thomas Archibald Roberts. Two distinct claims exist in the provided sources: (1) Document D1S1 and related segments assert that Thomas Archibald Roberts married Johannes Schwarzenberg, an Austrian politician. (2) Document D2S3 and related segments state that Thomas Archibald Roberts is married to Myra Elizabeth Tweedie, citing The Peerage as a source. Both claims are presented as direct assertions and are mutually exclusive regarding the same referent (spouse). Since neither source explicitly refutes the other and both are cited as authoritative within their own contexts, both answers are preserved as valid under the principle of distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers.
